from collections import Counter
program = '''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    src_cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (bg, 0)]
    zero_cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 0]
    sr0, sr1 = min(r for r, c in src_cells), max(r for r, c in src_cells)
    sc0, sc1 = min(c for r, c in src_cells), max(c for r, c in src_cells)
    zr0, zr1 = min(r for r, c in zero_cells), max(r for r, c in zero_cells)
    zc0, zc1 = min(c for r, c in zero_cells), max(c for r, c in zero_cells)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for dr in range(zr1 - zr0 + 1):
        for dc in range(zc1 - zc0 + 1):
            out[zr0 + dr][zc0 + dc] = grid[sr0 + dr][sc1 - dc]
    return out
'''
